jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Hiring for Raptor CX
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Raptor CX is a consulting and implementation firm that helps enterprises reimagine how they connect with customers in an AI-driven era. The team designs, builds and implements contact-centre (CCaaS), CXM and AI-agent platforms, with deep hands-on Sprinklr expertise across voice, chat, email, social, chatbots and analytics. Raptor CX works from Dubai and India with enterprise clients across Australia, Europe, the Americas and the Middle East, and is adding a Project Manager to own delivery as its implementation work grows.

About the Role

You'll own CCaaS and SaaS implementation projects end to end, from kick-off to go-live and hypercare, for international enterprise clients. You'll sit between the client, Raptor's consultants and technical teams, and keep delivery on time, on scope and visible.

This is a fully remote role from India. Your working hours follow the client you're delivering for and change from project to project: Australia roughly 8 AM–3 PM IST, the Americas roughly 10 PM–8 AM IST, the Middle East from about 5–6 AM IST, and Europe on overlap hours. You need to be genuinely comfortable switching schedules.

What you'll do

Run CCaaS / contact-centre platform implementations (e.g. Sprinklr) end to end: kick-off, requirements, solution design, configuration, integrations, UAT, go-live and hypercare
Build and own the project plan, milestones, RAID log and change requests
Lead client governance: weekly status reports, steering updates and escalations with senior client stakeholders
Coordinate Raptor consultants, solution architects and the client's IT and contact-centre teams
Plan and run UAT, cutover, agent and supervisor training, and adoption after launch
Track delivery against timelines, budget and KPIs, and flag risks early

What you bring

3–6 years as a Project Manager delivering client-facing implementations
Has taken at least one CCaaS / contact-centre platform implementation (preferred) or SaaS product implementation from kick-off to go-live for an external client
Has managed client stakeholders, timelines and cross-functional delivery teams on the same project
Comfortable working rotating hours for Australian, European, American and Middle Eastern clients
Clear, confident written and spoken English for client-facing communication
Based in India and able to join immediately

Nice to have

Hands-on projects on Sprinklr, Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Talkdesk or Salesforce Service Cloud
PMP or a similar project management certification
Experience with international enterprise clients
Agile/Scrum delivery and tools such as Jira or MS Project

jobs.description:
About Corgi

Corgi is building the next generation of financial institutions. We’re rethinking how insurance, financial products, and other complex financial services are built and operated from the ground up. We move quickly, work across disciplines, and expect people to take meaningful ownership from day one.

About the Role

We're looking for a Project Manager to drive cross-functional initiatives for our Engineering and Operations teams, owning the delivery of systems and workflows.

You'll translate business needs into clear technical requirements, align stakeholders, and drive projects from concept to delivery. This is a role for someone who combines strong project management skills, technical fluency, and action-oriented mindset.

What You'll Do

Own end-to-end delivery of projects across Engineering and Operations.
Translate complex operational challenges into clear requirements, priorities, and actionable plans.
Partner closely with engineers and business stakeholders to drive alignment and execution.
Manage project timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
Identify bottlenecks, proactively unblock teams, and continuously improve workflows.

Who You Are

Strong project and program management fundamentals.
An excellent communicator who can influence and align cross-functional stakeholders.
High ownership, proactive problem-solving, and a track record of getting things done.
Strong business and product intuition, with the ability to connect technical solutions to operational needs.
You can look at a messy process or a half-built workflow, identify what's wrong, and drive the fix.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience in project management, program management, or operations-focused product delivery.
Strong technical fluency and experience working closely with engineering teams and technical systems (data schemas, APIs, user interfaces, deployments), even if you aren't writing code.
Experience with TypeScript/Python/React stacks is helpful for communication, not required to code in them.
Very fluent with AI tooling.
Experience in fintech, insurance, or workflow automation is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose

We are currently recruiting for multiple Project Managers and Senior Project Managers. Our team includes world class experts and dynamic go-getters. This is a full-time position based in Calgary, Edmonton, or Vancouver.

The PM / Senior PM is accountable for the safe, compliant and successful delivery of complex projects and programs across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup and project closeout. This role establishes project objectives, execution strategies, governance and controls while leading multidisciplinary and multi-location teams throughout the project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will bring extensive project delivery experience, strong commercial and financial acumen, and the ability to develop trusted customer relationships. Working closely with customers, project teams, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Controls, Commercial, Contracts and Operations stakeholders, this role is responsible for delivering agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Governance

Define project objectives, execution strategies, governance requirements and success measures aligned with customer commitments and business priorities.
Provide visible leadership for health, safety, environmental performance, quality and ethical conduct across project teams.
Build, lead, mentor and develop high-performing multidisciplinary and multi-location teams.
Establish clear project accountabilities, decision-making authorities, communication protocols and reporting expectations.
Ensure project delivery methodologies, systems, tools and assurance requirements are applied throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead project reviews and provide direction on priorities, risks, opportunities, decisions and corrective actions.
Promote collaboration, accountability and timely escalation across customers, partners, contractors, suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Project Execution and Delivery

Lead projects from initiation and definition through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, handover and closeout.
Ensure project scope, execution plans, budgets, schedules, resource plans and deliverables are appropriately developed and maintained.
Coordinate with functional and discipline leaders to secure project resources and delivery commitments.
Oversee execution planning, constructability, maintainability and operability activities.
Monitor project performance and implement recovery strategies when safety, quality, cost or schedule objectives are at risk.
Manage project changes and ensure decisions, approvals and actions are properly documented and communicated.
Support successful project closeout, customer acceptance and lessons-learned activities.

Commercial, Financial and Contract Management

Provide leadership for project budgets, forecasts, revenue, margin, cash flow, contingencies and performance reporting.
Manage project scope and ensure changes are identified, evaluated, approved and implemented through formal change management processes.
Work closely with Commercial and Contracts teams to administer customer agreements and subcontract commitments.
Oversee procurement and contracting strategies appropriate to project delivery requirements.
Participate in the development, evaluation, negotiation and award of major contracts and work packages.
Identify commercial risks and opportunities and implement strategies to protect project and business outcomes.
Ensure project records support contractual compliance, audit requirements, claims management and reporting obligations.

Risk, Assurance and Stakeholder Management

Lead project risk and opportunity management processes and ensure effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
Ensure project assurance, technical reviews, stage-gate reviews and compliance activities are completed.
Oversee interfaces between customers, project teams, contractors, vendors, partners, regulators and other stakeholders.
Resolve organizational, contractual and cross-functional issues that could impact project delivery.
Escalate significant risks, disputes, claims and performance concerns when appropriate.
Foster continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across projects and project teams.

Customer and Business Leadership

Build and maintain trusted customer relationships through proactive communication and reliable project delivery.
Translate customer objectives into practical execution strategies and delivery plans.
Participate in project development, estimating, proposals, execution planning and customer presentations.
Support business growth through relationship management, networking, opportunity identification and successful project execution.
Represent Worley professionally with customers, contractors, partners and external stakeholders.
Contribute to project management capability development, succession planning and best-practice sharing.

What You Will Bring

Technical and Industry Experience

Progressive experience leading the delivery of complex industrial projects and programs.
Demonstrated experience as a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Project Director or comparable project leadership role.
Experience delivering projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup and closeout phases.
Strong knowledge of project management, project controls, cost management, forecasting, commercial management, contract administration, risk management and change management.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and multi-location teams in EPC, EPCM, PMC, consulting, owner or similar project delivery environments.
Experience managing customer relationships and communicating effectively with executive, operational and technical stakeholders.
Experience developing and implementing project execution plans, governance frameworks, reporting systems and recovery strategies.
Experience with major capital projects, brownfield and greenfield developments, and industrial facility upgrades is considered an asset.
Experience within energy, chemicals, resources, mining, metals, oil sands, SAGD, refining, midstream, gas processing, infrastructure, power, utilities, manufacturing or other industrial sectors.
Construction and field leadership experience is considered an asset.
Strong leadership, negotiation, decision-making, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills.

Required

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Project Management or a related discipline from a recognized institution, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Demonstrated project management experience supporting complex project delivery environments.

Preferred

Project Management Professional (PMP) designation or equivalent project management credential.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation or other relevant industry accreditation.
Experience using project controls and project management systems such as Primavera P6, EcoSys, SAP or equivalent.

For applicants based in the province of British Columbia, the salary range is $141,845 to $225,774

Application of the pay band: Variation in salary is determined by factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, relevant years of experience, geographic location, internal pay equity, and prevailing market conditions for the specific role.

Moving Forward Together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace, creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities and be part of delivering sustainable change.

jobs.title: Project Manager Civil
jobs.description:
Founded in 1963 by Don Fessler & George Bowman, Fessler & Bowman, Inc. has grown from a residential flatwork & basement wall contractor to a top 100 Commercial Concrete Contractor recognized across the nation. Keeping customer satisfaction as our fundamental core value has allowed Fessler & Bowman, Inc. to prosper for more than six decades.

Our Culture & Philosophy

Fessler & Bowman is a fast-paced and culture-focused industry leader in specialty concrete and civil earthwork. When we talk about culture at F&B, it is not just a plaque hanging in our lobby. Our values are our driving force and have allowed us to build a phenomenal team delivering best in class products to our customers.

Open & Constructive
Take Pride in Our Product
Relentless Commitment
Care About Our Customers
Team Success

Summary

Project Managers lead Project Teams in the successful completion of construction projects from the initial hand-off from Estimating through final completion and close-out. Project Managers are responsible for overall project planning and scheduling, resource allocation, project accounting, and control, while providing technical direction and ensuring compliance with quality standards and applicable laws and regulations. The descriptions below are representative of, but not limited to, the duties and responsibilities for this position.

Five Key Roles Of The Project Manager

Conduct Project Start-Up 2 weeks prior to the start of the project. Conduct Project Close-Out meetings within 45 days of completion on each project. Document and distribute accurate and complete meeting minutes including “Lessons Learned”.
Create, maintain, and close out accurate project budgets that track project financial performance including productivity. Ensure all budgets are updated weekly at minimum.
Ensure timely processing of the project A/R and A/P requirements in conjunction with corporate financial team support.
A/P processed > 7 days.
A/R processed in accordance with client requirements.
Receivables maintained under 60 days.
Ensure budgeted profitability is achieved on every project by collaborating with field operations. Field Production Report to be updated on a daily basis and reviewed/validated with field operations.
Manage the prime contract and prime contract change orders. Ensure work outside of the prime contract scope is only performed after receipt of written authorization to proceed.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Project procurement is submitted, approved, and completed in accordance with the project schedules and sequencing to ensure materials and subcontractors are available at the project site as needed by the field operations team.
Developing, maintaining, and cascading the project schedule to field operations and subcontractor(s). Ensure F&B activities are in compliance with the overall project schedule and validated with field operations. Resolve all scheduling conflicts with the customer.
Complete the Job Progress Report (JPR) process monthly.
Review Project Daily Log on each project daily for accuracy and completeness. Communicate concerns to the project teams and field operations.
Work closely with the General Superintendent and Equipment Director to ensure equipment usage does not exceed the budget. Review and communicate progress daily.
Prepare list of project issues and contribute to the weekly Regional Coordination Meeting. Identify and discuss project issues to seek resolution.
Report and escalate project risk management concerns to Regional Director.
Review all V-plans and sequencing plans with field operations to identify build issues. Submit solutions for review and approval to the client project team.
Communicate and collaborate with field operations on each project daily.
Lead, coach and develop PE’s and APM’s. Perform regular check-ins with them to ensure that developmental concerns are addressed and appropriate training is provided.
Perform project document process and control. Project documents include drawings, specifications, submittals, and RFI’s.
Review project safety requirements and collaborate with Regional Safety Manager to ensure that plan documents are updated and implemented with field operations at project start-up.
Secure all licensing and permits required for the project prior to starting the job and in accordance with all local state and municipal laws.
Secure all liability insurance, OCIP and/or CCIP prior to the start of the project according to contractual requirements and in line with F&B standard practices.
Secure all bonding according to the contract requirements and in line with F&B standard practices.
Communicating and upholding the Company’s commitment to Integrity and Code of Ethics, as well as ensuring the same for the entire team.
Other relevant tasks as assigned.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

A Bachelor of Science in Engineering preferred, or equivalent in training and experience.
At least five (5) years of relatable construction experience.
Creative and results-oriented, with a strong sense of urgency and self-motivation.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with an adaptable and flexible style in working with all types of individuals.

Travel

Travel is required for this position. Travel may include, but is not limited to, travel from office to various job sites. Fessler and Bowman will compensate for travel when applicable.

Work Environment

As a Project Manager, you will be subject to various work environments. Environments include but are not limited to the following: office and field settings, high/low temperatures, areas close to traffic, loud and frequent noises, confined spaces, heights, indoor/outdoor settings.

Benefits

jobs.title: Youth Program Manager
jobs.description:
LEAD PEOPLE. DRIVE EXCELLENCE. MAKE AN IMPACT.

NOW HIRING: PROGRAM MANAGER

The YMCA of the East Bay is seeking a driven, and people-centered Program Manager to lead our Y Scholars afterschool programs across multiple school communities.

We're looking for more than someone who can manage daily operations. We're looking for a leader who builds strong teams, develops future leaders, solves problems, drives accountability, and continuously raises the standard of excellence.

As a Program Manager, you'll lead and empower Site Coordinators, strengthen school partnerships, improve program operations, and help create exceptional learning experiences for hundreds of students.
You'll have the opportunity to make meaningful decisions, introduce new ideas, develop talented people, and directly influence the success and direction of our programs.

ABOUT THE YMCA Y SCHOLARS PROGRAM

We envision a world where every student discovers their purpose and achieves their full potential.
At the YMCA Y Scholars Program, we elevate youth voice and create opportunities for students to grow as learners, leaders, and engaged members of their communities.

Serving elementary and middle school students, our school-based afterschool programs combine academic achievement, physical activity, creative exploration, and social-emotional learning to help students thrive in school and beyond.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Position: Program Manager – YMCA Y Scholars Program
Start Date: Immediate
Compensation: $74,000–$80,000 annually, depending on experience
Employment Status: Full-Time, Exempt
Typical Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:30 PM
Locations: Multiple elementary and middle school sites throughout West Contra Costa and Oakland
Program Site Map: http://map.ymcayscholars.org

BENEFITS & PERKS

Free YMCA gym membership
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid holidays and paid time off
YMCA retirement plan
Ongoing professional training and leadership development
Opportunities for career growth and advancement within the YMCA
The opportunity to make a lasting difference in the lives of students, families, and communities

THE OPPORTUNITY: LEAD TEAMS. ELEVATE PROGRAMS. DELIVER RESULTS.

As a Program Manager, you'll oversee the success of multiple school-based afterschool programs by developing strong leaders, strengthening operations, and ensuring every site delivers safe, engaging, and high-quality experiences for students.

This is an active, hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys developing people as much as solving problems and achieving results. You'll spend your time coaching Site Coordinators, visiting school sites, building partnerships, analyzing performance, improving systems, and helping teams navigate challenges. You'll balance big-picture planning with the realities of daily operations, making decisions that strengthen both immediate performance and long-term program success. Most importantly, you'll build a culture where team members feel supported, understand what's expected of them, take ownership of their responsibilities, and are inspired to do their best work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead, Coach & Develop High-Performing Teams

Supervise, mentor, and empower Site Coordinators and program staff. Strengthen leadership capacity, provide meaningful feedback, address performance challenges, and cultivate a culture of trust, accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.

Champion Program Quality & Student Success

Set high standards for program excellence. Drive improvements in student engagement, academic support, enrichment, physical activity, and social-emotional learning while ensuring alignment with YMCA values and school district expectations.

Own Multi-Site Operations

Provide leadership and oversight across multiple school communities. Ensure effective staffing, scheduling, program implementation, safety practices, regulatory compliance, and consistent execution of operational standards.

Set Clear Expectations & Drive Accountability

Establish priorities, communicate performance expectations, monitor progress, and ensure follow-through. Recognize strong performance, address concerns constructively, and help teams consistently deliver on their commitments.

Build Strong School & Community Partnerships

Develop trusted relationships with school principals, district leaders, families, and community organizations. Strengthen collaboration, navigate challenges professionally, and identify opportunities to expand program impact.

Manage Budgets & Resources Responsibly

Oversee program budgets, staffing allocations, purchasing, and resource utilization. Make informed decisions that balance program quality, operational needs, and financial sustainability.

Use Data to Drive Improvement

Monitor enrollment, attendance, staffing, compliance, and program performance using Airtable, Google Workspace, and other management systems. Identify trends, develop action plans, and use measurable outcomes to guide decisions and improve results.

Recruit, Retain & Grow Talent

Lead staff recruitment, hiring, onboarding, training, and development in collaboration with YMCA Human Resources. Build strong teams, improve staff retention, and develop a pipeline of future YMCA leaders.

Strengthen Student & Family Experiences

Promote positive youth development, effective behavior management, meaningful family engagement, and responsive communication. Support teams in creating welcoming, inclusive, and supportive learning environments.

Solve Problems & Build Better Systems

Anticipate challenges, identify root causes, make sound decisions, and implement practical solutions. Improve processes, strengthen communication, and create systems that help teams operate more effectively and consistently.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a leader who understands that great management isn't about doing everything yourself. It's about building the people, systems, and culture that make exceptional results possible.
You know how to inspire and support a team while also setting clear expectations and holding people accountable.
You take initiative, follow through on commitments, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.
You're comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on problem-solving. You can manage competing priorities, make thoughtful decisions under pressure, and help others stay focused when circumstances change.
You don't settle for maintaining the status quo. You look for opportunities to make things better, whether that means developing a team member, improving a process, strengthening a partnership, or raising the quality of a program.
You believe that developing great people and delivering excellent programs go hand in hand.

YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

Bring Out the Best in People:
You genuinely enjoy coaching, mentoring, and helping others grow into confident, capable leaders.
Lead With Heart and Accountability:
You care about people, set clear expectations, recognize strong performance, and confidently address difficult conversations when necessary.
Take Ownership and Initiative:
You don't wait for someone else to solve a problem. You identify what needs to happen, take action, and follow through.
Think Strategically and Execute Effectively:
You turn ambitious goals into practical action plans, establish priorities, and deliver measurable results.
Build Trust and Strong Relationships:
You connect authentically with people, navigate different perspectives, and develop productive partnerships.
Make Sound Decisions:
You exercise good judgment, gather relevant information, and take decisive action even in challenging or changing circumstances.
Stay Organized and Adaptable:
You manage multiple sites, competing demands, and unexpected challenges while maintaining focus on your priorities.
Use Data to Improve Performance:
You look beyond numbers to understand what's working, identify opportunities, and take action to strengthen results.
Communicate With Clarity and Confidence:
You provide constructive feedback, navigate conflict professionally, and help people understand both the expectations and the purpose behind their work.
Embrace Growth and Continuous Improvement:
You welcome feedback, reflect on your leadership, and continually seek ways to improve yourself, your team, and your programs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in youth development, education, afterschool programs, expanded learning, or a related field.
Minimum of 1 year of supervisory, management, or team leadership experience.
Completion of at least 48 college units or a passing score on the California Instructional Aide Exam.
Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation for regular travel between school sites.
Ability to successfully complete DOJ/FBI background clearance.
Ability to obtain CPR, First Aid, AED, and Child Abuse Prevention certifications within 30 days of hire (training provided).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The following physical demands are representative of those necessary to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Sufficient strength, agility, and mobility to perform essential job duties and supervise program activities.
Ability to occasionally lift up to 30 pounds.
Frequent standing, walking, and bending throughout the workday.
Ability to walk for extended periods and move between program spaces.
Visual ability to effectively monitor activities in indoor and outdoor environments.
Ability to respond promptly to emergencies and other situations requiring immediate attention.

WHY JOIN THE YMCA OF THE EAST BAY?

Because your leadership should make a difference. At the YMCA, we believe leadership is about more than managing people and programs. It's about helping others succeed, creating opportunities, and building stronger communities.

jobs.description:

Hi, we're Speks, a New York-based product design company creating premium sensory products for teens and adults. We sell globally through major retailers including Target, Walmart and Barnes & Noble, specialty stores, international distributors, Amazon and our own website.

We're growing quickly and building a Merchandising team to make sure our customer programs are executed successfully from start to finish.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Key Accounts Program Manager to manage the execution of programs for our largest retail customers and international distributors.

Our key account programs often involve products, packaging and displays developed specifically for individual retailers. Each program has its own requirements, production timelines, inventory commitments and delivery deadlines.

Your job is to make sure every piece comes together.

You'll coordinate programs for major retailers such as Target, Walmart, Costco, Kohl's, Staples and Barnes & Noble, along with our international distribution partners.

You'll work across Sales, Merchandising, Product Development, Production, Planning, Operations and Finance to manage each program from initial planning through production, delivery and invoicing.

Turn customer commitments into detailed project plans with clear deadlines, deliverables and responsibilities.
Coordinate line reviews, product launches, displays, packaging, production, inventory availability and shipping timelines.
Work backward from customer delivery deadlines to establish milestones for every department.
Account for international production and shipping lead times, including factory holidays and Chinese New Year.
Identify potential delays and resolve problems before they affect customer commitments.

Sales & Merchandising Support

Prepare our sales team for customer meetings with product recommendations, sales performance, projections, samples, displays and marketing materials.
Gather customer requirements and communicate them to Merchandising and Product Development.
Help coordinate product assortments, packaging configurations and customer-specific programs.

Product Development & Compliance

Track the readiness of products, packaging, displays and other program components.
Make sure retailer and distributor requirements are understood and incorporated into production plans.

Production & Inventory Coordination

Coordinate with Planning to confirm inventory requirements and availability.
Track inbound shipments and identify potential delivery risks.
Flag conflicts involving production capacity, inventory availability or competing customer priorities.

Order Execution & Delivery

Coordinate with Operations to ensure customer setup, vendor portals, routing and shipping requirements are completed on time.
Monitor sales orders and shipments to ensure accurate, on-time and complete delivery.
Keep customers and internal stakeholders informed of program status and delivery dates.

Ensure invoices are accurate and retailer chargebacks or deductions are identified and addressed.
Review program results and identify improvements for future launches and customer programs.

Who You Are

5+ years of experience in program management, account operations, sales operations or export operations within consumer products, toys, gifts or hardgoods.
Experience managing programs for major retailers such as Target, Walmart, Costco or similar national accounts.
Strong understanding of manufacturing timelines, purchase orders, inventory, shipping and retailer compliance.
Experience coordinating projects involving multiple departments and external partners.
Highly organized, detail-oriented and capable of managing numerous deadlines simultaneously.
Proactive about identifying problems, following up and keeping projects moving without constant supervision.
Strong spreadsheet skills and experience working with retailer portals and operational systems.
Comfortable using AI tools and technology to improve efficiency, reporting and project management.
A practical problem-solver who takes ownership and follows through.

Nice to Have

Experience with international distributors and export operations.
Experience working with factories in Asia.
Familiarity with retailer vendor portals, EDI and routing compliance.
Experience managing customer-specific packaging, displays or product configurations.

Why Join Speks?

We're a fast-growing, entrepreneurial company where people have meaningful ownership over their work.

You'll work directly with leaders across the company and have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how successfully we deliver for our customers.

Reports to the Director of Merchandising
Program management and execution role, not a quota-carrying sales position

Position Summary At R-2 Contractors, we build the civil, structural, and underground infrastructure supporting America's utility-scale power & renewables industry. The Utility-Scale Power & Renewables Project Manager owns the commercial, contractual, financial, and administrative success of assigned projects from turnover through closeout. Working as a true partner to Field Operations, this leader anticipates risks, protects profitability, supports execution, and builds lasting customer relationships.

Position: Utility-Scale Power & Renewables Project Manager

Locations: Gilbert, AZ | Prineville, OR and or located on Project sites

Travel: Up to 20% nationwide

Compensation: $140,000$220,000 annually, DOE

Benefits: Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision benefits

Work Arrangement: On-site; remote work is not available

Project Leadership & Ownership

Lead assigned projects from estimating turnover and preconstruction through execution, customer acceptance, and final closeout.

Serve as the primary commercial and contractual point of contact for customers, general contractors, and project stakeholders.

Establish project priorities, responsibilities, decision deadlines, and clear communication between all participating departments.

Own commitments, solve problems proactively, and escalate material risks with recommended solutions.

Financial Accountability & Project Controls

Own project budgets, cost coding, commitments, and reliable estimates at completion, including labor, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and indirect costs.

Review budget versus actual costs, production-based earned hours, margin trends, and projected cost to complete with Field Operations.

Maintain accurate monthly forecasts, explain variances, and execute margin-protection and recovery plans.

Manage progress billings, payment applications, receivables, cash flow, and timely financial closeout.

Identify unbudgeted costs and pursue legitimate contractual cost recovery.

Preconstruction & Mobilization Readiness

Lead scope-letter, proposal, pricing schedule, contract, drawings, specification, and exclusion reviews at project turnover.

Build a mobilization-driven preconstruction schedule covering permits, access, submittals, shop drawings, procurement, fabrication, and deliveries.

Confirm material quantities, vendor lead times, subcontractor commitments, and approval requirements.

Partner with Field Operations to align staffing, equipment, critical milestones, and the first two weeks of executable work.

Identify scope gaps, design conflicts, and unresolved prerequisites before mobilization.

Scheduling & Field Execution Partnership

Own the contractual master schedule, milestone tracking, customer coordination, and documentation of schedule impacts.

Coordinate with Superintendents on the two-week lookahead, predecessor work, constraints, inspections, and resource readiness.

Communicate major foundation placements, shutdowns, mobilizations, and critical-path milestones early enough for operational support.

Support recovery plans and timely decisions without displacing Field Operations authority over means, methods, crews, and daily production.

Ensure current approved drawings, submittals, changes, and customer direction reach field leadership.

Contracts, Changes & Risk

Administer contractual notices, RFIs, submittals, correspondence, change directives, and required project records.

Identify, document, price, submit, negotiate, and track change orders, delays, differing conditions, and disruptions.

Capture supporting labor, equipment, material, and productivity records with Field Operations.

Maintain visibility into open commercial exposure, unresolved claims, and decisions required to protect R-2.

Coordinate safety, quality, testing, inspection, and corrective-action requirements with responsible field leaders.

Customer Relationships & Reporting

Build trust through timely, accurate, professional communication and consistent delivery of commitments.

Provide concise weekly reporting on project financial health, schedule, change orders, constraints, risks, and leadership decisions.

Keep action registers current with owners and due dates; promptly communicate significant changes to cost, scope, or schedule.

Identify repeat-work opportunities and share lessons learned with estimating, procurement, and operations.

Project Closeout & Continuous Improvement

Coordinate punch lists, turnover documents, as-builts, warranties, final acceptance, and outstanding commercial items.

Close open commitments and change orders, reconcile final costs, and support collection of final payment.

Lead lessons-learned reviews and improve planning, reporting, and project delivery systems.

Accountability Between Project Management & Field Operations

Project Management owns contractual and commercial administration, project forecasting, customer coordination, master scheduling, procurement coordination, and billing.

Onboard all participating organizations, execute network participation agreements, and lead the network-wide kickoff.
In partnership with clinical leadership, develop and deploy mobile-specific clinical protocols for Year 1 measures: depression screening (PHQ-2/9), diabetes control (HbA1c), and blood pressure.

Daily

Weekly

Share best practices and resources across the network.

Monthly
Lead Mobile Health Network meetings with members.
Convene shared learning sessions on clinical, operational, and data topics.

Visit each participating mobile health program on site at least once.
Deliver progress reports to partner organization summarizing network performance, clinical outcomes, operational milestones, and recommendations for program optimization.
Facilitate Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) quality improvement cycles with each organization.

Annually
Write a report on the network’s success, KPIs and growth, and set goals and objectives for the next year.
Develop post-grant sustainability models for each funded organization, including MCO reimbursement pathway analysis and Year 2+ expansion planning.
Extend clinical protocols to new measures, beginning with breast and colorectal cancer screening in Year 2.

Provide data-driven siting analysis using HPSA, Medicaid enrollment, and community-need data to optimize mobile clinic deployment locations and recurring routes.

Attitude: Embrace our culture and our SERVICE values

Experience with Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), primary care associations, and mobile health programs.
Experience managing grant-funded programs, preferred.

Understanding of community health needs, specifically in underserved populations.
Demonstrated strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and teamwork skills
Ability to work flexible hours including evenings/weekends as needed.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite

Comfortable standing, bending, and moving in a fast-paced environment

We live by our SERVICE values: Speed, Extraordinary Effort, Results, Valuing People, Integrity, Creativity, and Entertain always.

Monday through Friday 8am-5pm, with occasional evening or weekend events.

Information System Security Manager (ISSM)

The Information System Security Manager (ISSM) provides enterprise-level cybersecurity management, oversight, and leadership for Department of the Air Force Financial Management (DAF FM) systems. The ISSM ensures compliant implementation of cybersecurity policy, oversees the Risk Management Framework (RMF) lifecycle, guides the development and maintenance of authorization artifacts, and supports the Authorizing Official (AO) with risk-based decision materials. This role leads cybersecurity governance and collaborates closely with system owners, ISSOs, engineers, and program management staff to maintain security posture across all mission-critical FM systems.

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

Essential Requirements

The ability to obtain, maintain and access classified information at the Secret level.

Required Certification at the DoD 8570 IAM - Level III

Must comply with Air Force cybersecurity directives, including IAVA, TCNO, and NOTAM implementation and verification requirements

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead and oversee the RMF lifecycle across all DAF FM systems, ensuring security control implementation, assessment preparation, and continuous monitoring compliance

Provide enterprise cybersecurity program guidance to the AO, AODR, ISSOs, and system owners to ensure compliant application of DoD, federal, and Air Force cybersecurity policies.

Manage and review all FM security authorization artifacts—including SSPs, RARs, POA&Ms, and supporting documentation—in eMASS and ITIPS.

Oversee enterprise vulnerability and risk management, including analysis of findings, mitigation strategy development, and remediation coordination across multiple FM systems.

Prepare and deliver risk-informed decision packages for the AO (ATO, ATO with Conditions, Denial), including mission impact analysis and risk justification.

Coordinate cybersecurity governance activities, lead technical briefings, and provide updates to FM leadership on enterprise cyber posture and authorization status.

Ensure secure implementation of system modifications and verify cybersecurity impact following engineering changes.

Mentor and guide ISSOs, cybersecurity analysts, and engineering staff in RMF processes, security control requirements, and compliance procedures.

Key responsibilities

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Global Information Security Manager is nxzen's accountable day-to-day owner for information security governance and operations. The role will lead the ISMS, cyber risk and control environment, incident readiness, security assurance and the operating relationship with internal IT, offshore security resources, external SOC/providers, auditors and customers.
Own and mature nxzen's ISO 27001 ISMS, including policies, risk treatment, control ownership, objectives, evidence and management review.
Own the cyber risk register and monthly control/risk review, escalating material risk acceptance decisions to the Group COO / appropriate executive.
Lead vulnerability governance, remediation ageing and control effectiveness, working with onshore and offshore technical resources on execution.
Own incident triage and the cyber incident operating model; lead material incidents with Group COO involvement and specialist support where required.
Define and embed SOC operating responsibilities, escalation paths, playbooks and effectiveness testing.
Own security assurance for audits, certifications and customer requests, with specialist technical support used selectively for complex matters.
Lead BCDR security governance and support the broader business continuity programme, ensuring security and technology dependencies are understood and tested.
Own information-security policies and standards, including identity/access, device/security requirements and supplier security expectations.
Coordinate supplier security assurance and third-party information-security due diligence.
Drive recurring security awareness with People and Ch.
Produce clear monthly/quarterly security MI, risk and control reporting for the Group COO and ExCo/Board.

What we’re looking for

An operator rather than a policy-only security professional: someone who will make controls work day to day.
Commercial judgement and proportionate risk thinking, particularly in a business serving Critical National Infrastructure clients.
Confidence to challenge constructively and escalate when control or customer risk is material.
High ownership and follow-through without building unnecessary bureaucracy.
Someone comfortable creating structure from an immature starting point and then embedding it into BAU.
A collaborative leader who can work effectively with Jagadish/IT, Tracey/Compliance, P&C, Delivery, Finance, offshore teams and senior cyber specialists.
Customer-facing credibility: able to explain nxzen's security position clearly without overclaiming maturity.
A pragmatic mindset that balances security, user experience, delivery speed and cost.

Nice to have

Experience in utilities, energy, engineering, infrastructure, managed services or other regulated / Critical National Infrastructure sectors.
Experience with NIS / CAF, Cyber Essentials Plus, Achilles or comparable customer/supplier assurance frameworks.
Experience establishing or testing BCDR / cyber-resilience plans.
Previous responsibility for third-party/supplier security assurance.
Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor or equivalent.
Experience working with offshore security teams or distributed global operating models.
Experience presenting security risk/control positions to Boards, ExCo or major enterprise customers.
Understanding of OT / industrial cyber risk, even if deep OT assurance is provided by specialist colleagues.

Why join us?

At nxzen
, we’re more than designers, engineers, or consultants - we’re one global team with one shared purpose: to solve what matters and stand by it. For us, delivery isn’t the end; it’s the expectation. We stay accountable long after the work is done, because integrity, care, and lasting impact are at the heart of how we show up - for each other, for our customers, and for the systems we serve.
Joining nxzen means becoming part of a company that is advancing the national infrastructure society depends on
. Backed by leading investors and powered by domain expertise, engineering excellence, and digital innovation, we help energy, utilities, and infrastructure providers deliver safer, smarter, and more resilient operations
.
Here, you’ll:
Take on complex, high-stakes challenges that matter
— from shaping the energy transition to strengthening critical national systems.
Learn from and collaborate with global leaders and specialists
across consulting, engineering, and technology.
Be trusted to deliver and supported to grow
, with opportunities to sharpen your skills and expand your impact.
Join a team that values fresh thinking and real follow-through
, where your creativity will make a measurable difference.

This is work that lasts. Work that powers communities, protects critical networks, and accelerates progress toward net-zero. And it starts with people like you.

Benefits & perks

We want you to thrive both at work and in life. Here’s what we offer to support your wellbeing and career:
Pension scheme with a 5% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution, helping you build a secure future.
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providing confidential support when you need it most.
Electric Vehicle scheme to help you drive toward a greener future.
Life assurance at 4x your salary, giving you and your loved ones peace of mind.
Private healthcare to help you take care of yourself.
25 days’ annual leave + 8 bank holidays so you can rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters.
LinkedIn Learning access, giving you thousands of courses to sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
Free on-site parking, making your commute that bit easier.
Enhanced Maternity Pay
Signed Menopause Pledge

Our hiring process

We know your time is valuable, so we keep our process clear and straightforward:
Application review
– Our team will assess your CV and portfolio against the role requirements.
Initial interview
– A short call to understand your experience, skills, and motivations.
Practical task
– You may be given a short exercise to showcase your ability.
Final interview
– Meet with team leaders and Client Partners to discuss collaboration, technical skills, and fit.
Offer & onboarding
– If successful, you’ll receive an offer and begin your journey with nxzen

We value fairness, speed, and respect at every stage of the process. You’ll always know where you stand, and we’ll provide feedback along the way.

Diversity & inclusion statement

As a global technology, consulting, and engineering partner, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual is valued and empowered to contribute their unique talents. We embrace diversity in all its forms – across gender, ethnicity, culture, and experience – and are dedicated to creating a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Together, we drive innovation and deliver excellence to our clients.

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Security Analyst - EMEA
jobs.description:
Listed on CyberJobs.cc, a job board for cybersecurity jobs from the team behind AITraining.jobs.

Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.

As a Senior Cyber Security Analyst, you will leverage your expertise in bot detection, web traffic analysis, and deep behavioral analytics to identify and investigate anomalous activities within our hCaptcha SaaS security platform.

Your primary responsibilities will include conducting advanced investigations of potential automated and human threats, analyzing complex patterns and behaviors, and developing actionable insights to enhance our security posture. Working closely with other teams, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of our AI/ML detection and response capabilities, ensuring that our platform remains resilient against evolving cybersecurity challenges.

Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.

What will you do

Monitor, identify and analyze events from a range of sources to spot threats and respond to such incidents with a sense of urgency.
Collaborate with globally distributed teams to accomplish tasks.
Assist in the collection of metrics to measure the efficiency of Security Operations functions.
Audit the effectiveness of security measures to check if the systems meet the Security compliance norms.
Assist in implementation of security policies and procedures.
Fine-tune of the process and eventually update standard operating procedures for the team.
Participate in various stages of incident investigations and threat hunting engagements.
Work closely with internal company teams such as Product, Customer Success, etc.

What we are looking for

Exposure to web and API security, coding standards, WAFs, advanced persistent threat actors, botnets (off the shelf and custom) and attack mitigation.
Hands-on SQL proficiency is a must-have.
Knowledge of managing, securing and preparing production web environments with tools like Kubernetes.
Familiar with Threat Hunting - Web/API, web hacking, web data analysis or WAF hands-on experience.
In-depth knowledge of the web technology and web application security field.
Deep understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape, and the attacker mindset.
Experience in scripting and programming (JavaScript, Python, etc.).
Interest in keeping up with industry trends and market demands to recommend product enhancements and new sources of intelligence.
Demonstrated interest in working with data and metrics as applied to security.
A great collaborator and communicator who stays curious and enjoys innovating. Nothing stands still in security.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with open source analytics and visualization tools like Grafana, Redash, etc.
Experience red-teaming, especially developing bot-nets and whitehat hacking.
Hands on knowledge on Web security modules and secure configuration.
Hands-on experience and proficiency in API test automation and standardization.
Experience and solid knowledge on computer and network security.
Integrating security into build automation, deployment automation, test automation, SDLC orchestration, environment management, monitoring, and production.
Mentor development teams, review pull requests, and guide evolution of the development pipeline.
Experience with modern application packaging, deployment, containerisation, bug tracking tools and other supporting tools (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).
Familiar with ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001), SOC2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls and Open Web Application Security Project.

What we offer

Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!

Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Notice: This position does NOT work remotely.

Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be responsible for the development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of Health Hub data and recurring reports as well as dashboards and other business intelligence applications that utilize the underlying data stores for internal and external use under the Health Hub Program. This includes tracking encounter and quality outcome data from electronic health records (NextGen), i2i, HMIS, Microsoft Office platforms, and health plan reports.

The Data Analyst will also support multidisciplinary teams, including medical providers, nursing, behavioral health, case management, and administrative staff with data reporting needs. Reporting includes Capitation and Fee-for-Service (FFS) Reconciliation reports, monthly dashboards, provider productivity reports, and more. The Data Analyst will thoroughly analyze and clarify report requirements, make recommendations, and provide education when necessary to meet business needs. They will also be responsible for creating and maintaining internal controls and reference materials to promote data quality.

Principal Responsibilities

Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data systems and databases, including identifying and correcting coding errors, data discrepancies, and other data-related issues to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Collect, analyze, report, and monitor encounter data and quality outcome measures from NextGen, i2i, health plan reporting systems, and other applicable data sources to support Health Hub Program requirements.
Extract, organize, clean, and transform data from primary and secondary sources into meaningful formats that support organizational decision-making, program evaluation, and reporting requirements for county contractors and other stakeholders.
Apply statistical methods and analytical tools to interpret datasets, identify trends and patterns, and support diagnostic, predictive, and performance improvement analyses.
Evaluate and interpret data within the context of local, national, and industry-wide trends to identify potential impacts, opportunities, and challenges affecting the organization and its programs.
Prepare reports for program directors and executive leadership that clearly communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data.
Collaborate with programmers, IT staff, and organizational leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend system modifications, and support the development of data governance policies.
Collaborate and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external consultants within the data network to extract, evaluate, and deliver data requested by county representatives on a monthly and quarterly basis.
Develop and maintain clear documentation of data collection, extraction, validation, and analysis methodologies to support transparency, reproducibility, and verification of reported information.
Develop, update, and maintain data reference materials, including data dictionaries, codebooks, reporting specifications, and standardized documentation to promote consistency and accuracy across reporting processes.
Design, develop, implement, and maintain business intelligence dashboards and data visualizations using a user-centered design approach to ensure information is clear, accessible, accurate, and meaningful to the intended audience.
Coordinate the ordering, inventory tracking, monitoring, and replenishment of medical supplies and other program-related materials requested by Program Directors, ensuring requests are processed and fulfilled in accordance with established organizational procedures.
Adhere to all organizational safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.
Participate in required safety and compliance training and apply learned practices in daily work activities.
Identify, report, and help mitigate unsafe conditions, incidents, or hazards in the workplace.
Use equipment, tools, and supplies safely and responsibly in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
Maintain awareness of infection control, occupational health, and emergency preparedness procedures appropriate to the role.
Participate in JWCH’s customer service training called AIDET on an annual basis.
Demonstrate an understanding of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, and Thank You) to apply in patient encounters or team discussions.
Utilize the AIDET communication framework to communicate with patients and team members in a manner that reduces patient anxiety, increases patient compliance, and improves clinical outcomes.

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Minimum of two years of demonstrated experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Specialist, or in a data management and reporting support role, preferably in a healthcare, behavioral health, or nonprofit setting.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications, with demonstrated experience using databases and analytical tools, including macros, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), pivot tables, pivot charts, queries, and data filters.
Experience working with NextGen Electronic Health Records (EHR) or a comparable electronic medical records (EMR) system, including the ability to develop, execute, and maintain data queries and reports.
Experience using web-based data reporting portals, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP), and other platforms for data exchange, retrieval, and reporting.
Knowledge of healthcare data management, reporting requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local funding requirements related to healthcare services.

Knowledge, Skills And Ability

Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into meaningful insights.
Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, validate, analyze, and communicate large volumes of information with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, organizational leadership, external consultants, and community partners.
Experience working in a nonprofit, healthcare, or human services environment preferred.
All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

Medical, Dental, Vision
Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.
Funded Health Savings Account (up to deductible) to assist with carrier-approved medical expenses.
Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
Mileage reimbursement.
Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

JWCH Institute, Inc + Wesley Health Centers
is an Equal Opportunity and Fair Chance Employer.

This position is 100% on-site no remote.

Committed. Innovative. Engaged.

Your Next Opportunity:

As our Supplier Quality Program Manager, you will establish and drive a robust program to ensure the quality and reliability of materials and services delivered by Rosendin's supply chain partners. This pivotal role directly impacts our project success, operational efficiency, and reputation for excellence in electrical construction across the nation. Manage and maintain a centralized database of approved suppliers, including their qualification status, performance records, and audit results.
Develop and deliver training programs for internal teams on supplier quality processes, risk identification, and performance monitoring.
Track, analyze, and report key supplier quality performance indicators (KPIs) to leadership, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Support the qualification of new suppliers, ensuring their capabilities and quality systems align with Rosendin's requirements.

What You'll Need to Be Successful:

Proven ability to design, implement, and manage comprehensive quality programs within a complex supply chain environment.
Strong understanding of quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001), methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), and audit techniques.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a data-driven approach to continuous improvement.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Proficiency in project management principles and tools, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
Knowledge of electrical construction materials, components, and common industry quality standards.
Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion) and quality management software.
Demonstrated leadership and influencing skills to drive change and achieve program objectives without direct authority over all contributing parties.

What You Bring to Us:

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
5-8+ years of progressive experience in supplier quality, procurement, or supply chain management, preferably within the construction, manufacturing, or electrical industry.
Certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) are highly preferred.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing supplier relationships in a program management capacity.

Translate customer objectives into practical execution strategies and delivery plans.

Support business growth through relationship management, networking, opportunity identification and successful project execution.
Represent Worley professionally with customers, contractors, partners and external stakeholders.
Contribute to project management capability development, succession planning and best-practice sharing.

Technical and Industry Experience

Progressive experience leading the delivery of complex industrial projects and programs.
Demonstrated experience as a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Project Director or comparable project leadership role.
Experience delivering projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup and closeout phases.
Strong knowledge of project management, project controls, cost management, forecasting, commercial management, contract administration, risk management and change management.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and multi-location teams in EPC, EPCM, PMC, consulting, owner or similar project delivery environments.
Experience managing customer relationships and communicating effectively with executive, operational and technical stakeholders.
Experience developing and implementing project execution plans, governance frameworks, reporting systems and recovery strategies.
Experience with major capital projects, brownfield and greenfield developments, and industrial facility upgrades is considered an asset.
Experience within energy, chemicals, resources, mining, metals, oil sands, SAGD, refining, midstream, gas processing, infrastructure, power, utilities, manufacturing or other industrial sectors.

Strong leadership, negotiation, decision-making, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills.

Demonstrated project management experience supporting complex project delivery environments.

Preferred

new_jobs.description:
About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose

We are currently recruiting for multiple Project Managers and Senior Project Managers. Our team includes world class experts and dynamic go-getters. This is a full-time position based in Calgary, Edmonton, or Vancouver.

The PM / Senior PM is accountable for the safe, compliant and successful delivery of complex projects and programs across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup and project closeout. This role establishes project objectives, execution strategies, governance and controls while leading multidisciplinary and multi-location teams throughout the project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will bring extensive project delivery experience, strong commercial and financial acumen, and the ability to develop trusted customer relationships. Working closely with customers, project teams, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Controls, Commercial, Contracts and Operations stakeholders, this role is responsible for delivering agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Governance

Define project objectives, execution strategies, governance requirements and success measures aligned with customer commitments and business priorities.
Provide visible leadership for health, safety, environmental performance, quality and ethical conduct across project teams.
Build, lead, mentor and develop high-performing multidisciplinary and multi-location teams.
Establish clear project accountabilities, decision-making authorities, communication protocols and reporting expectations.
Ensure project delivery methodologies, systems, tools and assurance requirements are applied throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead project reviews and provide direction on priorities, risks, opportunities, decisions and corrective actions.
Promote collaboration, accountability and timely escalation across customers, partners, contractors, suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Project Execution and Delivery

Lead projects from initiation and definition through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, handover and closeout.
Ensure project scope, execution plans, budgets, schedules, resource plans and deliverables are appropriately developed and maintained.
Coordinate with functional and discipline leaders to secure project resources and delivery commitments.
Oversee execution planning, constructability, maintainability and operability activities.
Monitor project performance and implement recovery strategies when safety, quality, cost or schedule objectives are at risk.
Manage project changes and ensure decisions, approvals and actions are properly documented and communicated.
Support successful project closeout, customer acceptance and lessons-learned activities.

Commercial, Financial and Contract Management

Provide leadership for project budgets, forecasts, revenue, margin, cash flow, contingencies and performance reporting.
Manage project scope and ensure changes are identified, evaluated, approved and implemented through formal change management processes.
Work closely with Commercial and Contracts teams to administer customer agreements and subcontract commitments.
Oversee procurement and contracting strategies appropriate to project delivery requirements.
Participate in the development, evaluation, negotiation and award of major contracts and work packages.
Identify commercial risks and opportunities and implement strategies to protect project and business outcomes.
Ensure project records support contractual compliance, audit requirements, claims management and reporting obligations.

Risk, Assurance and Stakeholder Management

Lead project risk and opportunity management processes and ensure effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
Ensure project assurance, technical reviews, stage-gate reviews and compliance activities are completed.
Oversee interfaces between customers, project teams, contractors, vendors, partners, regulators and other stakeholders.
Resolve organizational, contractual and cross-functional issues that could impact project delivery.
Escalate significant risks, disputes, claims and performance concerns when appropriate.
Foster continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across projects and project teams.

Customer and Business Leadership

Build and maintain trusted customer relationships through proactive communication and reliable project delivery.
Translate customer objectives into practical execution strategies and delivery plans.
Participate in project development, estimating, proposals, execution planning and customer presentations.
Support business growth through relationship management, networking, opportunity identification and successful project execution.
Represent Worley professionally with customers, contractors, partners and external stakeholders.
Contribute to project management capability development, succession planning and best-practice sharing.

What You Will Bring

Technical and Industry Experience

Progressive experience leading the delivery of complex industrial projects and programs.
Demonstrated experience as a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Project Director or comparable project leadership role.
Experience delivering projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup and closeout phases.
Strong knowledge of project management, project controls, cost management, forecasting, commercial management, contract administration, risk management and change management.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and multi-location teams in EPC, EPCM, PMC, consulting, owner or similar project delivery environments.
Experience managing customer relationships and communicating effectively with executive, operational and technical stakeholders.
Experience developing and implementing project execution plans, governance frameworks, reporting systems and recovery strategies.
Experience with major capital projects, brownfield and greenfield developments, and industrial facility upgrades is considered an asset.
Experience within energy, chemicals, resources, mining, metals, oil sands, SAGD, refining, midstream, gas processing, infrastructure, power, utilities, manufacturing or other industrial sectors.
Construction and field leadership experience is considered an asset.
Strong leadership, negotiation, decision-making, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills.

Required

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Project Management or a related discipline from a recognized institution, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Demonstrated project management experience supporting complex project delivery environments.

Preferred

Project Management Professional (PMP) designation or equivalent project management credential.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation or other relevant industry accreditation.
Experience using project controls and project management systems such as Primavera P6, EcoSys, SAP or equivalent.

Application of the pay band: Variation in salary is determined by factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, relevant years of experience, geographic location, internal pay equity, and prevailing market conditions for the specific role.

Moving Forward Together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace, creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities and be part of delivering sustainable change.
